name: DailyDialog
description: Multi-turn chit-chat corpus with about 13k dialogues. Related dialogue datasets include PersonaChat, Topical-Chat, and EmpatheticDialogues; each source has its own terms, which should be reviewed independently. No data is vendored.
citation: DailyDialog: A Manually Labelled Multi-turn Dialogue Dataset. Li et al., 2017.
